title: Chaucer's Meter and Rhyme
subtitle: Iambic pentameter, heroic couplets.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Iambic pentameter, rhyming couplets (heroic couplets). Enjambment rare; each couplet tends to close a thought. Caesura mid-line. Practice scansion on ten couplets. The meter is regular; the syntax flexible.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Chaucer's Meter and Rhyme.
